name: BCA AI/ML
description: Bachelor of Computer Applications in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

semesters.name: Semester 1
semesters.description: Discrete Structures, C Programming, Computer Architecture, and Constitutional Values

subjects.name: Discrete Structure
subjects.description: Mathematical structures that are fundamentally discrete rather than continuous, crucial for algorithmic computation.

units.name: Unit 1: Set Theory
units.description: Sets, relations, functions, and Cartesian products with cardinality proofs.

units.name: Unit 2: Logic and Counting
units.description: Propositional calculus, truth tables, quantification rules, and combinatorics principles.

units.name: Unit 3: Matrices
units.description: Matrix algebra, systems of linear equations, eigenvalues, and eigenvectors.

units.name: Unit 4: Graph Theory
units.description: Graphs, trees, planar graphs, Eulerian/Hamiltonian paths, and coloring.

materials.name: Set Theory & Relations Solved Proofs.pdf
materials.details: Step-by-step mathematical proofs of power sets, bijection mapping, and equivalence relations.

materials.name: Truth Tables & Combinatorics Practice.pdf
materials.details: Midterm prep booklet with 45 solved examples of permutations, logic formulas, and quantifiers.

subjects.name: Problem Solving Techniques
subjects.description: Introduction to logical design, algorithms, and modular programming concepts in C language.

units.name: Unit 1: Introduction
units.description: Algorithm development, flowchart design, pseudo-code structures, and program life cycle.

units.name: Unit 2: C Programming
units.description: C syntax, control loops, arrays, structures, pointers, and custom helper functions.

units.name: Unit 3: Factoring Methods
units.description: Greatest common divisor, prime factorization, square roots, and number generation algorithms.

units.name: Unit 4: Sorting
units.description: Array searching and fundamental sorting techniques such as bubble, selection, and insertion.

materials.name: Interactive Pointer Demos.java

subjects.name: Computer Architecture
subjects.description: Explores the fundamental structure, circuits, register operations, and Assembly level organization of computers.

units.name: Unit 1: Number System
units.description: Binary, octal, hexadecimal representations, floating point conventions, and binary arithmetic.

units.name: Unit 2: Combinational Circuits
units.description: Boolean logic gates, Karnaugh maps minimization, multiplexers, decoders, and arithmetic units.

units.name: Unit 3: Basic Computer Organization and Design
units.description: Instruction cycles, CPU registers, timing signals, memory reference codes, and microprogram control.

units.name: Unit 4: Introduction to 8085 Assembly Language
units.description: 8085 microprocessor register architecture, instruction sets, addressing modes, and simple assembly programs.

materials.name: K-Map Simplification Guide.pdf
materials.details: Comprehensive guide to 3, 4, and 5 variable K-Maps with grouping and don't care conditions.

subjects.name: Constitutional Values I
subjects.description: Introduction to the founding ideals, Preamble, and fundamental rights of the Indian Constitution.

units.name: Constitutional I
units.description: Preamble, historical framing, fundamental rights, and citizenship clauses.

subjects.name: Language 1: English
subjects.description: Literary chapters, communication drafting, grammar fundamentals, and professional vocabulary.

units.name: English Chapters
units.description: Assigned prose, poetry, business correspondence layout, and writing mechanics.

subjects.name: Language 2: Kannada/Hindi/Additional English
subjects.description: Second language literature, regional grammar models, essays, and regional syntax studies.

units.name: Language 2 Curriculum
units.description: State approved text chapters, grammatical systems, prose essays, and translation grids.

subjects.name: Practical Labs (Sem 1)
subjects.description: Practical files, execution scripts, and viva records for computer architecture, problem-solving, and office automation.

units.name: Computer Architecture Lab
units.description: Design combinational circuits using digital gates simulators and assemble micro-logic scripts.

units.name: Problem Solving Lab
units.description: Write, compile, test, and debug structured computational programs using GCC compiler and C.

units.name: Office Automation Tool (OMT)
units.description: Leverage standard processors, slide decks, database files, and dynamic sheets calculation.

materials.name: C Language Lab Manual Completed.pdf
materials.details: Full set of 15 standard lab programs including bubble sort, matrix transpose, and pointer structures.

semesters.name: Semester 2
semesters.description: Data Structures, OOPs using Java, Operating Systems, and Environmental Studies

subjects.name: Data Structures
subjects.description: Foundational techniques of storing and retrieving non-linear and linear data efficiently in modern computer systems.

units.name: Unit 1: Introduction and Overview
units.description: Data classification, algorithm analysis, asymptotic notations, and complexity structures.

units.name: Unit 2: Arrays
units.description: Linear arrays, representation in memory, traversal, insertion, deletion, and search bounds.

units.name: Unit 3: Stacks
units.description: Stack operations, push-pop operations, infix to postfix conversions, and queues implementation.

units.name: Unit 4: Binary Trees
units.description: Tree schemas, traversing binary trees, searching, heap representation, and search trees.

subjects.name: OOPs using JAVA
subjects.description: Object-Oriented design, classes, interfaces, inheritance schemes, and virtual machine structures.

units.name: Unit 1: Introduction
units.description: History of Java, bytecode, JVM, variables, data types, operators, and control loops.

units.name: Unit 2: Inheritance
units.description: Method overloading, overriding, class hierarchal extends, interfaces, and packages.

units.name: Unit 3: Event Handling
units.description: Delegation event model, listeners, mouse/key event captures, and UI widgets.

units.name: Unit 4: Exception Handling
units.description: Try-catch-finally, throwing custom errors, assert frameworks, and multicatch blocks.

subjects.name: Operating System
subjects.description: Kernel design, system calls, process state, CPU allocation, memory translation, and filesystems.

units.name: Unit 1: Introduction
units.description: OS types, microkernel architecture, system calls, and boot sequences.

units.name: Unit 2: Process Synchronisation
units.description: Semaphores, critical section problems, classical lock structures, and CPU scheduling.

units.name: Unit 3: Memory Management Strategies
units.description: Paging systems, segmentation, translation lookaside buffers, and virtual memory page swaps.

units.name: Unit 4: Introduction to LINUX Programming
units.description: Linux shell scripting, file management commands, piping, and administrative tools.

subjects.name: Environmental Studies
subjects.description: Natural resources, eco systems, pollution, biodiversity conservation, and green computing foundations.

units.name: Eco Systems & Pollution
units.description: Global warming, local biodiversity, renewable energy resources, and computer recycling.

subjects.name: Constitutional Values II
subjects.description: State organs, local governance models, parliamentary rules, and emergency guidelines.

units.name: Constitutional II
units.description: Judiciary system, Union Executive, amendment methodologies, and local panchayats.

subjects.name: Practical Labs (Sem 2)
subjects.description: Interactive lab exercises for Data Structures, Java Programming, and Linux command shells.

units.name: Data Structure Lab
units.description: Implement arrays, stacks, queues, and tree navigations using C structures.

units.name: OOPs using JAVA Lab
units.description: Code custom classes, interface systems, exception trees, and mouse event frames.

units.name: Linux & Shell Programming Lab
units.description: Write bash execution scripts, grep files pattern searches, and cron management automation.

semesters.name: Semester 3
semesters.description: DBMS, Python Programming, Design & Analysis of Algorithms, and Feature Engineering

subjects.name: Database Management System
subjects.description: Core architectures, normalization, storage engines, transactional integrity, and PL/SQL procedures.

units.name: UNIT – I Fundamentals of Database Systems and Architecture
units.description: DBMS schemas, data independence models, ER diagrams, and relational algebra operations.

units.name: UNIT – II Database Design and Storage Structures
units.description: Keys mappings, file structures, indexing formats (B-Trees), and functional dependencies.

units.name: UNIT – III Relational Model, Normalization and SQL
units.description: 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF validation, query expressions, nested subqueries, and table constraints.

units.name: UNIT – IV Query Processing, Transactions and PL/SQL
units.description: ACID properties, serializability, query optimization, locks, cursors, and triggers.

subjects.name: Python Programming
subjects.description: Write clean, object-oriented script pipelines, manipulate files, and harness powerful data visualization modules.

units.name: UNIT – I Foundations of Python Programming
units.description: Variables, dictionary/tuples structures, conditional checks, loop structures, and functional scopes.

units.name: UNIT – II Data Structures and File Handling
units.description: Regular expressions, JSON mapping, read-write filesystem logs, and exception hierarchies.

units.name: UNIT – III Object-Oriented Programming and Data Handling Libraries
units.description: Classes, decorators, magic functions, NumPy matrix array calculation, and Pandas datasets.

units.name: UNIT – IV Data Analysis and Visualization
units.description: Plotting line graphs with Matplotlib, heatmaps in Seaborn, and exploratory summaries.

subjects.name: Design and Analysis of Algorithms
subjects.description: Examine complexity, divide-and-conquer, greedy designs, dynamic programming, and optimization.

units.name: UNIT - I Fundamentals of Algorithm Design and Computational Efficiency
units.description: Growth rates, recurrences trees, Master Theorem formulas, and algorithm validation.

units.name: UNIT – II Algorithm Design Techniques
units.description: Divide and conquer (Quick/Merge sort), greedy tactics (Kruskal, Prim, Huffman).

units.name: UNIT - III Optimization Techniques
units.description: Dynamic programming (Knapsack 0/1, LCS, Floyd-Warshall) and backtracking algorithms (N-Queens).

units.name: UNIT – IV Understanding Algorithmic Complexity & Problem-Solving Method
units.description: P vs NP classes, approximations limits, branch-and-bound optimization, and travelling salesperson.

subjects.name: Feature Engineering
subjects.description: Extracting, transforming, cleaning, and encoding datasets for robust AI/ML models.

units.name: Unit - I Introduction
units.description: Importance of feature space, domain expertise extraction, types of variables, and model biases.

units.name: Unit – II Data Cleaning, Transformation and Encoding
units.description: Imputing null values, outlier capping, log transform normalizers, one-hot encoding, and min-max scaling.

subjects.name: Practical Labs (Sem 3)
subjects.description: Practical databases, python script execution, and algorithmic complexity benchmarking.

units.name: Database Management System Lab
units.description: Run DDL/DML clauses, nested select join statements, and compile customized PL/SQL scripts.

units.name: Python Programming Lab
units.description: Code files IO engines, manipulate databases with sqlite3, and plot multidimensional graphs.

units.name: Design and Analysis of Algorithms Lab
units.description: Implement merge, quick, prim, heap sorts, and measure execution times.

subjects.name: english
subjects.description: prose and poems

units.name: Unit 1: Introduction
units.description: Foundational insights of english

units.name: Unit 2: Standard Concepts
units.description: Core practices and mechanisms of english

units.name: Unit 3: Applied Practice
units.description: Intermediate problem solving and labs for english

units.name: Unit 4: Advanced Systems
units.description: Theoretical models and future trends in english

semesters.name: Semester 4
semesters.description: Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, Internet of Things, and Data Visualization

subjects.name: Artificial Intelligence
subjects.description: Core searching strategies, logical inferences, machine learning principles, and ethical AI safeguards.

units.name: UNIT – I Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence and Search Techniques
units.description: BFS, DFS, heuristic searches (A*, Hill Climbing, Game playing with Alpha-Beta pruning).

units.name: UNIT – II Knowledge Representation, Reasoning, and Learning Paradigms
units.description: Predicate logic resolutions, semantic networks schemas, bayesian probability networks.

units.name: UNIT – III Planning, Reasoning and Perception
units.description: Classical planning algorithms, STRIPS representations, natural computer vision bounds, and audio models.

units.name: UNIT – IV Machine Learning, Neural Networks, and AI Ethics
units.description: Supervised classifiers, backpropagation, deep layers, and safety protocols.

subjects.name: Data Analytics
subjects.description: Empirical regressions, analytics frameworks, hypothesis validation, and Power BI visual dashboards.

units.name: UNIT- I Introduction to Data Analytics
units.description: Descriptive vs prescriptive analytics, life cycle of data science, sampling.

units.name: UNIT- II Correlation & Regression
units.description: Pearson r coeff, multi-linear regressions fitting, residuals analysis.

units.name: UNIT-III Probability & Statistical Methods
units.description: Z-tests, T-tests, ANOVA tables calculation, confidence bounds.

units.name: UNIT-IV Power BI
units.description: DAX calculations, query editors, modeling fields, and interactive chart publishing.

subjects.name: Internet of Things
subjects.description: Physical sensors, communication protocols, cloud aggregators, and system nodes automation.

units.name: UNIT - I Introduction and Applications
units.description: IoT definitions, physical structures, sensors, gateways, smart homes.

units.name: UNIT - II M2M and System Management
units.description: Machine-to-machine interfaces, SDN configurations, SNMP networks.

units.name: UNIT III Developing Internet of Things
units.description: Microcontrollers (Arduino, Raspberry Pi), pin triggers, sensor integration.

units.name: UNIT IV Usage of Python
units.description: Writing lightweight socket code scripts, REST APIs triggers, and data feeds.

subjects.name: Data Visualization
subjects.description: Graphic storytelling, design philosophies, and dashboard tools (Tableau, D3.js).

units.name: UNIT – I: Introduction to Data Visualization and Tools
units.description: Choosing correct chart formats, cognitive perceptions, and basic BI suites.

units.name: UNIT – II: Data Storytelling and Visualization Design
units.description: Narratives layouts, visual contrast, dashboards organization, and user heatmaps.

subjects.name: Probability and Statistics
subjects.description: Random variables, continuous curves, Bayes Theorem, and distribution models.

units.name: UNIT - I Fundamentals of Probability and Theorems
units.description: Conditional probability, Bayes formula, independent events, and sample space.

units.name: UNIT - II Random Variables and Probability Distributions
units.description: Normal, Binomial, and Poisson distributions curves with density algorithms.

subjects.name: Practical Labs (Sem 4)
subjects.description: Python notebooks and models for AI algorithms, statistical regressions, and IoT sensors.

units.name: Artificial Intelligence Lab
units.description: Implement A* searches, heuristic minimax trees, and simple neural net weight calculators.

units.name: Data Analytics Lab
units.description: Write Python pandas correlations, linear regression fitting, and Power BI dashboard layouts.

units.name: Internet of Things Lab
units.description: Wire sensor interfaces to Raspberry Pi, log sensor inputs, and write trigger scripts.

semesters.name: Semester 5
semesters.description: Machine Learning, Digital Image Processing, NLP, and Quantitative Techniques

subjects.name: ML and Neural Network
subjects.description: Explore neural networks, single-layer models, multi-layer perceptrons, backpropagation, and classification bounds.

units.name: Unit 1: Fundamentals of Machine Learning
units.description: Supervised and unsupervised learning, bias-variance tradeoff, classification boundaries.

units.name: Unit 2: Single Layer Perceptron
units.description: Activation functions, weight adjustments, linearly separable outputs, and gate learning.

units.name: Unit 3: Multi-Layer Neural Networks
units.description: Hidden layers architectures, activation functions (ReLU, Sigmoid, Softmax), and weight matrices.

units.name: Unit 4: Training & Backpropagation
units.description: Gradient descent, error backpropagation formulas, learning rates, and optimization.

subjects.name: Digital Image Processing
subjects.description: Examine matrix representation of images, filters, sharpening, edge segmentation, and compression models.

units.name: Unit 1: Image Representation
units.description: Pixels matrices, sampling, quantization, color models (RGB, YUV, HSV).

units.name: Unit 2: Enhancement & Filtering
units.description: Histogram equalization, smoothing filters, gaussian blur, and sharpening.

units.name: Unit 3: Edge Detection
units.description: Sobel, Prewitt, Canny operators, and image segmentation techniques.

units.name: Unit 4: Compression
units.description: Lossless vs lossy techniques, JPEG compression models, and discrete cosine transforms.

subjects.name: Natural Language Processing
subjects.description: Tokenizers, grammatical tagging, language model architectures, and sentiment analyzers.

units.name: Unit 1: Tokenization & Syntax
units.description: Text preprocessing, stemmers, lemmatizers, and regular expression models.

units.name: Unit 2: POS Tagging
units.description: Part-Of-Speech tagging, chunking, and named entity recognition architectures.

units.name: Unit 3: Language Models
units.description: N-grams, TF-IDF weights, word embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe), and transformers.

units.name: Unit 4: Sentiment Analysis
units.description: Classifier training, transformers pipeline, and document semantic checks.

subjects.name: Quantitative Techniques
subjects.description: Linear optimization models, transportation models, queuing theory, and minimax game solvers.

units.name: Unit 1: Linear Programming
units.description: Formulating linear constraints, Simplex method solvers, and dual models.

units.name: Unit 2: Network Analysis
units.description: PERT and CPM charts, project timeline optimizations, and critical paths.

units.name: Unit 3: Game Theory
units.description: Pure vs mixed strategies, saddle points, and multi-player payoff tables.

units.name: Unit 4: Decision Theory
units.description: Decision making under risk, expectation matrix evaluation, and utility functions.

subjects.name: Practical Labs (Sem 5)
subjects.description: PyTorch modeling and OpenCV scripts for machine learning and digital image segmentation.

units.name: ML and Neural Network Lab
units.description: Train backpropagation nets in PyTorch and plot loss optimization curves.

units.name: Digital Image Processing Lab
units.description: Apply Sobel edges and custom filters kernels on OpenCV image matrices.

semesters.name: Semester 6
semesters.description: Computer Vision Deep Learning, Predictive Analysis, and Capstone Project Work

subjects.name: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
subjects.description: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), object localized tagging, image masks, and GANs generators.

units.name: Unit 1: Convolutional Neural Networks
units.description: Pooling filters, padding formulas, kernel weight structures, and ResNet models.

units.name: Unit 2: Object Detection
units.description: YOLO classification models, bounding box regression, intersection-over-union metric.

units.name: Unit 3: Image Segmentation
units.description: Semantic vs instance classification, UNet models, and pixel-level mask tags.

units.name: Unit 4: GANs
units.description: Generators and Discriminators training pipelines, synthetic images generation.

subjects.name: Predictive Analysis
subjects.description: Forecasting mathematical trends, logistic modeling regressions, and ensemble trees algorithms.

units.name: Unit 1: Linear & Logistic Models
units.description: Fittings mathematical variables, log-likelihood ratios, and confusion matrix validation.

units.name: Unit 2: Time Series Forecasting
units.description: ARIMA statistical formulas, trend indicators, stationarity checks, and LSTM models.

units.name: Unit 3: Ensemble Learning
units.description: Random Forests models, AdaBoost frameworks, and XGBoost gradient boosters.

units.name: Unit 4: Model Evaluation
units.description: K-fold cross-validation, ROC curves analysis, and precision-recall tradeoffs.

subjects.name: Project Work
subjects.description: Full-scale software development and deployment. Requires database design, modeling, and system verification.

units.name: Unit 1: System Requirement Analysis
units.description: Flowcharting specifications, data dictionary models, and architecture design.

units.name: Unit 2: Interface Design
units.description: Responsive component layouts and REST API route blueprints.

units.name: Unit 3: Core Implementation
units.description: Backend models construction, frontend bindings, and database migrations.

units.name: Unit 4: System Integration & Testing
units.description: Deploying nodes, stress tests, security logs verification, and project thesis.

subjects.name: Soft Skills
subjects.description: Professional workplace communication, team project management, resumes composition, and public speaking.

units.name: Unit 1: Interpersonal Communication
units.description: Active listening, collaborative writing, and constructive peer reviews.

units.name: Unit 2: Resume Building
units.description: Drafting punchy technical summaries, formatting achievements, and organizing GitHub repositories.

units.name: Unit 3: Interview Mastery
units.description: Answering algorithmic whiteboard challenges and behavioral scenario questions.

units.name: Unit 4: Public Speaking
units.description: Structuring a technical presentation, designing clear slide decks, and managing Q&A.
